vopros: What do you know about Vita Kamliuk, a real estate agent in Los Angeles? Which brokerage is she with?

vyzhimka.tekst:
Vita Kamliuk is a licensed Los Angeles real estate agent currently affiliated with Compass. Compass’s official agent directory lists her as REALTOR®, California DRE #02166055, with specialties including buyer representation, listings, relocation, and property management. She works in English and Russian. ([compass.com](https://www.compass.com/agents/vita-kamliuk/?utm_source=openai))

Her background is somewhat more extensive than a typical residential-agent profile. According to her professional materials, she has roughly 18 years of real-estate experience, including earlier commercial-real-estate work with Knight Frank and Colliers International before moving into Los Angeles residential real estate. Her current focus includes the San Fernando Valley and the Westside—areas such as Sherman Oaks, Valley Village, Studio City, Tarzana, Westwood, Beverly Hills, and West Hollywood. ([askvita.com](https://askvita.com/?utm_source=openai))

She was previously with Keller Williams Beverly Hills. A 2022 VoyageLA profile identifies her as working at the Keller Williams Beverly Hills office at that time, so older references to Keller Williams are not necessarily erroneous; she subsequently moved to Compass. ([voyagela.com](https://voyagela.com/interview/exploring-life-business-with-vita-kamliuk-of-keller-williams/?utm_source=openai))

As of September 2026, multiple current sources confirm the Compass affiliation, including her official Compass profile and recent professional posts identifying her as “Vita Kamliuk | DRE #02166055 | Compass.” ([compass.com](https://www.compass.com/agents/vita-kamliuk/?utm_source=openai))

If you're considering hiring her, I can also look into her recent sales/listings, transaction history, reviews, and licensing record to give you a more independent picture of her track record.
